definition.en: NADAC is the average price pharmacies pay to buy a medicine from wholesalers. Medicaid publishes it every week. You cannot buy medicine at this price — it is a fair-price yardstick.
definition.zh-Hans: NADAC 是药房从批发商那里购买一种药的平均价格。Medicaid 每周公布一次。您无法以这个价格买到药——它是用来衡量价格是否公道的标尺。

definition.en: A program, often run by a drug company, that gives medicine for free or at low cost to people who qualify. Most have an income limit and need a form signed by your doctor.
definition.zh-Hans: 常常由药厂开办的计划，为符合条件的人免费或低价提供药物。大多数计划有收入限制，并需要您的医生签字的表格。

definition.en: The federal poverty level is an income amount set each year by the government. Programs use a percent of it, like 138%, to decide who can get help. It depends on how many people are in your household.
definition.zh-Hans: 联邦贫困线是政府每年定下的一个收入标准。各项计划用它的百分比（例如138%）来决定谁可以得到帮助。具体数额取决于您的家庭人数。

definition.en: A generic medicine has the same active ingredient, strength and effect as the brand. It usually costs much less.
definition.zh-Hans: 仿制药与品牌药的有效成分、剂量和效果都相同。它通常便宜很多。

sources.name: FDA — Generic drug facts
sources.note: Official page address from general knowledge; not opened in this build (network blocked). The weekly link checker confirms it loads.

definition.en: A biosimilar is a medicine very close to a brand-name biologic, like insulin, with no meaningful difference in safety or effect. An "interchangeable" biosimilar can be swapped at the pharmacy where state law allows.
definition.zh-Hans: 生物类似药是与品牌生物药（例如胰岛素）非常接近的药物，在安全性和效果上没有实质性差别。在州法律允许的地方，“可互换”的生物类似药可以在药房直接替换。

definition.en: A copay is the fixed amount you pay for a prescription when you use insurance.
definition.zh-Hans: 共付额是您使用保险时，为一个处方药支付的固定金额。

definition.en: The amount you pay for covered care each year before your insurance starts to pay.
definition.zh-Hans: 每年在保险开始付钱之前，您需要先为承保的医疗服务支付的金额。

definition.en: The list of medicines your insurance plan covers. Medicines are often grouped in tiers that cost different amounts.
definition.zh-Hans: 您的保险计划承保的药物清单。药物常常分成不同等级，费用各不相同。

definition.en: For Medi-Cal and Covered California, your household is usually you, your spouse, and the people you claim on your taxes. Ask the county or an enroller if you are not sure.
definition.zh-Hans: 对 Medi-Cal 和 Covered California 来说，您的家庭通常包括您本人、您的配偶，以及您报税时申报的人。如果不确定，请询问县政府或注册顾问。

definition.en: Count money you earn from work before taxes, plus things like unemployment and Social Security. The county or an enroller can tell you exactly what counts.
definition.zh-Hans: 请计算您工作赚的税前收入，再加上失业救济金和社会安全福利金等。县政府或注册顾问可以告诉您具体哪些要算进去。

definition.en: A Medicare program that helps people with limited income and savings pay for prescription drugs.
definition.zh-Hans: Medicare 的一个计划，帮助收入和储蓄有限的人支付处方药费用。

definition.en: A free coupon from a website like GoodRx or SingleCare that can lower the cash price at a pharmacy. The price depends on the pharmacy. It usually cannot be used together with insurance.
definition.zh-Hans: 来自 GoodRx 或 SingleCare 等网站的免费折扣券，可以降低药房的现金价。价格因药房而不同。它通常不能和保险一起使用。
